scoring_justification: Recompute from raw DFT band structure data is not feasible in the checker; comparing the agent's reported computed quantities to the paper's reference values with tolerances appropriate for code-to-code variation is acceptable.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for band gap, binding energy, effective masses for hollow-pattern stanene/MoS2 heterostructure
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's Table 1 values
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper-reported values; the checker compares the agent's reproduced results to them as the reference for successful reproduction.

band_gap_eV.description: Direct band gap at the K point in eV.

binding_energy_meV_per_Sn.description: Binding energy per Sn atom in meV.

effective_mass_electron_KM.description: Electron effective mass along K-M in units of free electron mass m0.

effective_mass_electron_KG.description: Electron effective mass along K-Γ in units of free electron mass m0.

effective_mass_hole_KM.description: Hole effective mass along K-M in units of free electron mass m0.

effective_mass_hole_KG.description: Hole effective mass along K-Γ in units of free electron mass m0.

outputs.description: JSON file containing the six scored quantities computed from the DFT calculations.

output_contract.notes: Only the hollow pattern and PBE level (no SOC) are required. The values are the agent's computed results; the hidden checker compares them to reference values.
